skill.name: answer-me-with-html
skill.description: Create visual HTML explainers from extended Markdown with diagrams, comparison tables, code excerpts, and optional narrated videos.
skill.summary: Turn complex answers into local, interactive HTML pages using a bundled Node.js CLI.
skill.author: qingyuna

security_audit.summary: Most supplied matches concern embedded assets, parser syntax, or secret-blocking checks; no evidence found of destructive intent or audit-targeted prompt injection. Speech transport, implicit cloud narration, and optional plaintext LAN sharing create credential and privacy risks. All 400 supplied findings are adjudicated; 1,812 unpresented matches still require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/2212 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 1812 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Configured speech requests can send credentials and narration over remote plaintext HTTP.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS for non-loopback speech endpoints, reject URL credentials, and revalidate redirects before forwarding authorization headers.

remediation.issue: Automatic voice selection treats an existing ElevenLabs key as permission to upload narration.
remediation.suggestion: Default to system speech or subtitles. Require an explicit provider choice before sending narration to a cloud service.

remediation.issue: Optional LAN sharing exposes bearer capability links over plaintext HTTP on every IPv4 interface.
remediation.suggestion: Retain loopback defaults and require explicit sharing consent. Prefer a selected interface with HTTPS or a trusted encrypted tunnel.

remediation.issue: The static analyzer presented only 400 of 2,212 matches.
remediation.suggestion: Review the remaining 1,812 matches and verify bundled dependency provenance before enabling automatic publication.

content.user_title: Turn Complex Answers Into Visual HTML Explainers
content.value_statement: Complex explanations can hide relationships and trade-offs in long text. This skill turns Markdown drafts into visual HTML pages with diagrams, tables, and focused panels.
actual_capabilities: Render extended Markdown into single-file HTML pages with automatic layout, themes, and light or dark presentation.
Build flow, sequence, entity relationship, tree, timeline, and chart components from text.
Quote selected workspace code lines while checking paths, sensitive filenames, and common secret patterns.
Embed existing local images and collect reader decisions, panel comments, and remarks.
Patch one panel in an existing generated page while retaining its presentation settings.
Create video player pages with optional narration and export MP4 or WebM when required tools are available.
limitations: Page generation requires Node.js 20 or newer; CLI video export requires Node.js 22 and a compatible browser.
MP4 export also requires ffmpeg; narration depends on configured speech services or installed system tools.
Cloud speech can transmit narration, and configurable speech endpoints do not enforce secure transport.
Generated pages retain embedded content; secret checks do not replace manual review before sharing.

use_cases.title: Explain Request Flows
use_cases.description: Show request paths, service relationships, and state changes with diagrams and selected code excerpts.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Options
use_cases.description: Present decision criteria, trade-offs, and open questions in a visual comparison page.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical Lessons
use_cases.description: Convert a structured lesson into scenes with diagrams, captions, and explicitly selected narration.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Explainer
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain [topic] as one HTML page with a conclusion, one diagram, and a short comparison table. Do not open the browser automatically.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: turn a question into a visual answer.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] across [criteria]. Create an HTML page with evidence, trade-offs, and one decision question.

prompt_templates.title: Document Existing Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain [workspace subsystem] with a request-flow diagram and selected code excerpts. Cite real files and identify private content before sharing the HTML.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect diagrams to repository evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Offline Lesson
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-scene video explaining [process]. Use recurring diagram labels, subtitles, and voice off. Keep the player local and report export prerequisites.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: create a video without cloud narration.

output_examples.input: Explain how a cache handles requests.
output: A local HTML page with a request-flow diagram showing cache hits and misses.
A comparison table explains latency, freshness, and failure behavior.
A conclusion panel states when cached data is returned.

output_examples.input: Explain the TCP handshake as a video with voice off.
output: A local player page presents connection setup as captioned scenes.
A sequence diagram reveals SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK in order.
The player includes scene navigation, playback speed, and export controls.

best_practices: Use one question per panel and place the core conclusion before supporting evidence.
Review embedded code and images before sharing a page or enabling network access.
Select voice off or system speech for private narration unless cloud processing is explicitly approved.
anti_patterns: Do not use charts with invented numbers or present sketches as verified project code.
Do not treat reader comments or unanswered suggested options as authorization to run commands.
Do not send credentials through remote HTTP speech endpoints or share private page links over untrusted networks.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The instructions cover Claude, Claude Code, and Codex. Hosts without CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR substitution must use the actual skill directory path.

faq.question: Does page generation need dependency installation?
faq.answer: The bundled CLI needs Node.js 20 or newer. Ordinary page rendering does not require installing additional Node packages.

faq.question: Where are generated pages stored?
faq.answer: Pages normally use the application data directory. Output flags can select a workspace file, and restricted writes can trigger private temporary storage.

faq.question: Does it work without network access?
faq.answer: Local page rendering can work offline. Disable update checks and avoid remote themes and cloud narration when network access is prohibited.

faq.question: Can narration send text to external services?
faq.answer: Yes. Auto voice selects ElevenLabs when its API key exists. Use voice off or system speech to avoid that cloud upload.

faq.question: Can I safely share every generated page?
faq.answer: No. Review embedded content first. Optional LAN sharing uses HTTP, and anyone holding a valid page link can access that page.
